phy-code-smell 1.0.0

- Initial release of a static code smell detector supporting Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, and Ruby.
- Identifies 10 classic code anti-patterns with per-smell severity ratings and line-level findings.
- Provides actionable refactoring suggestions for each detected issue.
- Runs with zero external dependencies.
- Works via simple trigger phrases and requires no configuration.
